scope.tool_policy: read-only review; separate workflow owns edits

findings.issue: Shared central entity descriptions differ between homepage and algorithm pages
findings.decision: Use single authoritative registry; keep existing stable IDs; reference shared nodes instead of redefining full unrelated pages.

findings.issue: Stale page-specific descriptions following metadata optimization
findings.decision: Synchronize page and article descriptions to accurate content; preserve distinct entity definitions, titles/headlines consistent with visible page.

findings.issue: Unicode Text Tools collection description still says eight languages/regions
findings.decision: Verify actual visible list and available locale links; use accurate collection markup, do not conflate languages with 17 tools.
Verify actual ownership and authorship; only mint stable organization identity after verification; no fabricated people or social URLs.

findings.issue: Article dates unchanged after substantive edits
findings.decision: Compare real content changes and visible dates; preserve publication dates; update only when supported by actual substantive modification.

findings.issue: About and Privacy have no JSON-LD
findings.decision: Optional accurate AboutPage/WebPage markup; no invented legal facts and no mandatory rich-result expectation.

gates: Inventory actual current JSON-LD, typed nodes, ID definitions/references, sameAs, DOI, visible breadcrumb/itemlist, author and date evidence, canonical URL, mainEntity and page mission; distinguish external citation references from missing internal nodes.
Validate domain/range and schema.org vocabulary plus eligible Google features separately.
Reconcile multi-definition nodes without treating complementary graph triples as necessarily conflicting.
Separate original scholarly papers from site's commentary and researcher identity from site authorship.
Check actual internal content links; no relationship fabricated purely for schema.
No forced FAQs/ratings, no automatic date refresh, no keyword-stuffed description, no promises of ranking/rich results.
Run exact allowed-file delta QA and static+browser QA; preserve noindex on Preview, canonical URLs, locale tools and body except approved visible corrections.
limitations: Eight selected pages inspected; full current 91-page and 17-tool schema audit not yet run. No Google Rich Results or Schema Markup Validator result claimed.
